Project Money connects four parts of your money, so each answer builds on the one before it.

  1. Plan: your pay minus your monthly bills shows how much you can spend and save.
  2. Spending: your expenses show whether this month is on track.
  3. Saving: goals show what to set aside each month.
  4. Trips: shared costs show what you owe or are owed.
